tools.name: book_call
tools.description: Open the calendar to book a call with the openstatus team. Use for sales, demos, or onboarding requests.

tools.name: open_dashboard
tools.description: Open the openstatus dashboard (signed-in app). Use when the user wants to log in, sign up, or manage their workspace.

tools.name: open_discord
tools.description: Open the openstatus Discord community for support and discussion.

tools.name: open_docs
tools.description: Open the openstatus documentation site (docs.openstatus.dev). Use when the user wants reference material, API docs, or how-to guides.

topic.description: Optional search term to focus the docs landing (e.g. 'mcp', 'cli', 'terraform').

tools.name: open_github
tools.description: Open the openstatus GitHub repository. Use when the user wants source code, issues, or to self-host.

tools.name: view_blog
tools.description: Navigate to the openstatus blog index.

tools.name: view_changelog
tools.description: Navigate to the openstatus changelog. Use when the user asks about recent updates, releases, or what's new.

tools.name: view_pricing
tools.description: Navigate to the openstatus pricing page. Use when the user asks how much openstatus costs or which plan to choose.

tools.name: view_status
tools.description: Open the openstatus public status page so the user can see whether the platform itself is healthy.
